User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the MithilaCab application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, matches Auth UID.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the user joined.

emergencyContact.description: An emergency contact for the user.

phone.description: Phone number of the emergency contact.

isSuspended.description: Indicates if the user's account is suspended.

suspensionReason.description: The reason why the user's account was suspended.

role.description: Defines the user's role, granting different permissions.

savedAddresses.description: User's saved addresses for quick booking.

isActive.description: Whether the user has an active Power Pass.

expiryDate.description: The date when the Power Pass expires.

Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description: Represents a driver in the MithilaCab application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Driver entity, matches Auth UID.

name.description: The full name of the driver.

email.description: The email address of the driver.

phone.description: The phone number of the driver.

vehicle.description: The model of the driver's vehicle (e.g., 'Suzuki Swift').

isAvailable.description: Indicates if the driver is available for new rides.

isSuspended.description: Indicates if the driver's account is suspended.

suspensionReason.description: The reason why the driver's account was suspended.

isVerified.description: Indicates if the driver's documents have been verified.

image.description: Represents a placeholder image with metadata.

id.description: The unique identifier for the image placeholder.

description.description: A brief description of the image.

imageHint.description: Keywords to help AI find a replacement image.

dateJoined.description: The date and time when the driver joined.

documents.description: URLs to the driver's uploaded verification documents.

rc.description: URL to the vehicle registration certificate (RC).

insurance.description: URL to the vehicle insurance document.

pollution.description: URL to the pollution under control (PUC) certificate.

Ride.title: Ride
Ride.description: Represents a ride booked through the MithilaCab application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Ride entity.

passenger.description: Denormalized passenger information for driver access.

photoURL.description: URL of the passenger's profile picture.

pickupLocation.description: The pickup location for the ride.

destinationLocation.description: The destination location for the ride.

fareAmount.description: The fare amount for the ride.

distance.description: The estimated distance of the ride in kilometers.

startTime.description: The start time of the ride.

endTime.description: The end time of the ride.

rating.description: The rating given by the user for the ride.

status.description: The status of the ride (e.g., scheduled, ongoing, completed, cancelled).

rideType.description: The type of ride selected (e.g., Standard, Premium, SUV).

comment.description: Optional comment left by the user after the ride.

isFlagged.description: Indicates if the ride has been flagged for a safety emergency.

Incentive.title: Incentive
Incentive.description: Represents a promotional incentive for drivers.

title.description: The name of the incentive program (e.g., 'Weekend Warrior').

description.description: A short description of the incentive's goal.

isActive.description: Whether the incentive is currently active.

PlatformSettings.title: Platform Settings
PlatformSettings.description: Global settings for the MithilaCab platform.

commissionRate.description: The percentage (0-1) of the fare taken as commission.

surgeMultiplier.description: A global multiplier for fares during peak times (e.g., 1.5 for 50% surge).

currency.description: The default currency code for the platform (e.g., 'INR').

rideTypeSettings.description: Pricing settings for different ride types.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a single wallet transaction for a user.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines a user role and its associated permissions within the application.

name.description: The display name of the role (e.g., 'Administrator').

description.description: A brief description of what the role entails.

permissions.description: A list of permission strings granted to this role.

Refund.title: Refund
Refund.description: Represents a refund request for a completed ride.

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund request.

rideId.description: The ID of the ride being refunded.

userId.description: The ID of the user requesting the refund.

fareAmount.description: The fare amount of the ride in question.

reason.description: The user's detailed reason for requesting the refund.

status.description: The current status of the refund request.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was made.

processedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was processed.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a special event for which ride pooling is available.

name.description: The name of the event (e.g., 'Mithila Vivah Season').

description.description: A short description of the event.

destination.description: The primary destination address for the event.

isActive.description: Whether the event pooling is currently active.

bannerImageUrl.description: URL for the event's promotional banner image.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure security, scalability, and ease of debugging, following the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, and DBAC. It leverages denormalization and structural segregation to simplify security rules and enable secure list operations. The structure focuses on path-based ownership for user-specific data and avoids complex hierarchical authorization dependencies.

*   **Authorization Independence:** User and Driver data are stored directly under their respective collection, eliminating the need to fetch parent documents for authorization. Ride data, while referencing User and Driver, does not inherit authorization contexts, preventing dependencies.  The `userId` and `driverId` are denormalized into the `Ride` documents, which allows for atomic creation of parent/child documents without compromising authorization.
*   **Clarity of Intent:** Each collection serves a specific purpose, making the intent of each path clear. The naming conventions are semantic and consistent, aiding in debugging.
*   **DBAC (No Custom Claims):** Authorization relies solely on `request.auth.uid`, using the existence of documents in dedicated collections (e.g., `/drivers/{driverId}`) to imply roles.
*   **QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure supports secure `list` operations by segregating data based on ownership (users, drivers) and access control (roles).
